_meta: Tiers come from ProtonDB (run sync_protondb.py or let the GitHub Action do it). Notes/runtimes/sysctl are curated by hand: PR fixes. 'blocked': true marks games the developer blocks on Linux. distro_overrides example: {"fedora": {"extra_packages": ["pkg"], "winetricks": ["verb"], "env": {"K": "V"}, "launch_options": "%command%"}}

steamos.note: Immutable: user-space fixes only (Proton, protontricks, launch options).

games.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition
AION 2
games.notes: UE5 NCSoft MMO (Steam 3393110). Windows-only. ProtonDB Gold. Prefer GE-Proton; check live reports if login/overlay issues.

games.name: Albion Online
games.notes: Native Linux client. No Proton needed.

games.name: Among Us
games.notes: Works well on Proton or native where available.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.notes: Reported as blocked/unsupported on Linux by the developer. Check ProtonDB before playing.

games.name: ARK: Survival Ascended
games.notes: Large UE5 title: a higher vm.max_map_count avoids crashes on older distro defaults.

games.name: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon
Baldur's Gate 3
games.notes: Native Linux build. Use the Vulkan option if the default fails.

games.name: Battlefield 2042
games.notes: Anti-cheat blocks Linux/Proton by developer choice. Check ProtonDB before buying.

games.name: Black Desert
games.notes: Launcher can show a black window on first run; relaunching usually fixes it.

games.name: Black Myth: Wukong
games.notes: Let shaders finish compiling on first start. Keep Mesa/NVIDIA drivers current.

games.name: Brothers - A Tale of Two Sons
Call of Duty: Black Ops III
Counter-Strike 2
games.notes: Native Linux client. Competitive matchmaking works.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
games.notes: NVAPI var only matters on NVIDIA GPUs (DLSS).

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic
games.notes: Rock solid. No special options needed for most players.

games.name: Destiny 2
games.notes: Reported as blocked/unsupported on Linux by the developer. Check ProtonDB before playing.

games.name: DOOM Eternal
games.notes: Very good on Proton. Ray tracing works on supported hardware with recent drivers.

games.name: El Shaddai ASCENSION OF THE METATRON
Elden Ring
games.notes: Online play needs the EAC runtime (installed automatically). Launching the game exe directly gives offline play without EAC.

games.name: Elite Dangerous
games.notes: Works; launcher can be slow on first start.

games.name: Fallout 76
games.notes: Bethesda.net; variable online status on Proton.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV Online
games.notes: Run the launcher once so the prefix exists.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
games.notes: Works well on current GE-Proton. Rockstar Launcher can be finicky; if it fails, try deleting the Rockstar Games folder in the prefix and re-auth.

games.name: Hell Let Loose
games.notes: Needs the EAC runtime; works when the developer has Linux EAC enabled.

games.name: HELLDIVERS 2
games.notes: Anti-cheat support has varied between updates; check ProtonDB before big patches.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
games.notes: Low vm.max_map_count causes crashes on some distros. First launch compiles shaders; expect a long load.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
games.notes: Use native if available; else GE-Proton.

games.name: Killing Floor 2
games.notes: Works well. Some players prefer GE-Proton for stability with workshop content.

games.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga
Lies of P
games.notes: Generally smooth on a current GE-Proton.

games.name: Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name
Marvel Rivals
games.notes: Needs a recent GE-Proton; long first-launch shader compile.

games.name: Monster Hunter: World
games.notes: Generally excellent. Online features work with current Proton.

games.name: No Man's Sky
games.notes: Works well. Occasional multiplayer desync reports; restarting the session usually fixes it.

games.name: Overwatch 2
games.notes: Works through Steam on a current Proton.

games.name: Palworld
games.notes: UE5 shader compile on first launch.

games.name: Path of Exile
games.notes: If the default renderer misbehaves, switch the in-game renderer between Vulkan and DX11.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.notes: Use a current GE-Proton; try the Vulkan renderer if you see stutter.

games.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
games.notes: Anti-cheat blocks Linux/Proton by developer choice. Check ProtonDB before buying.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.notes: Large title; first launch shader compile is long. Use a recent GE-Proton.

games.name: Remnant II
games.notes: Large UE5 title: a higher vm.max_map_count avoids crashes on older distro defaults.

games.name: Rocket League
games.notes: Epic-owned; free-to-play via Steam. Runs well on recent Proton. Online matchmaking works for most players.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
games.notes: UE5 shader-compile stutter. Needs a recent GE-Proton and an up-to-date Vulkan driver.

games.name: Satisfactory
games.notes: Runs well. Dedicated server support is separate (often native).

games.name: SILENT HILL 2
games.notes: Large UE5 title: a higher vm.max_map_count avoids crashes on older distro defaults.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.notes: Classic. Script Extender (SKSE) users should prefer a current GE-Proton and check load order tools.

The Last of Us Part II Remastered
The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt

games.name: Throne and Liberty
games.notes: Needs the EAC runtime. Reports vary by patch; check ProtonDB.

games.notes: Anti-cheat blocks Linux/Proton by developer choice. Check ProtonDB before buying.

games.name: Total War: ROME II - Emperor Edition
Wallpaper Engine

games.notes: Native Linux client available. Prefer the native build over Proton.
